text:
The dish is a small round compostable plate, probably about 18-20 cm across. It holds roughly 4-5 pieces of cooked steak, medium-rare and seasoned, in a pile about 8 cm across.

Mass: the pieces are each about 5x3x2 cm, which is roughly 30-40 g each. Five pieces come to about 150 g.

Energy: seasoned, seared steak runs about 200 kcal per 100 g. That puts 150 g at around 300 kcal, so I'm estimating 290 kcal.
